verdict.rationale: USPTO is a government patent and trademark filing and records service. It has no user-authored automation layer, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability: the saved AIR forms, the API version change, and the training mode are not automation versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
